name: Home Assistant, Print Blueprint
description: Shows what your Bambu Lab printer is printing as a blueprint of the part, with live print data from Home Assistant. Needs the Bambu Lab integration: https://github.com/greghesp/ha-bambulab

cell_options.name: printer
cell_options.label: Printer
cell_options.help: Any printer from the Bambu Lab integration in Home Assistant. Blank shows the first one found.

cell_options.name: method
cell_options.label: Picture
cell_options.help: Availability depends on the printer. Save and reopen to refresh. Toolpaths draws the real paths from the sliced file. Line art traces the slicer preview and also works for cloud prints. AI engraving repaints the preview once per print with kie.ai (about US$0.02, needs the kie.ai key in the widget settings). Compare all three for your current print at /plugins/print_blueprint/compare

cell_options.name: editor_preview
cell_options.label: Preview
cell_options.help: Only affects previews. Example works offline. Live print draws free toolpaths or line art; the example stays until that method is ready. AI uses an existing engraving only; a real screen render must create it first.

cell_options.name: background
cell_options.label: Paper
cell_options.help: Dashboard look follows the dashboard's colours and font. A cell look overrides Paper. Blue is the fallback if the look is unavailable.

cell_options.name: show_progress
cell_options.label: Show progress
cell_options.help: Preview line art shades the printed fraction from the bottom up. Toolpaths dash the unprinted layers. Off shows the plain drawing without a layer marker.

cell_options.name: button_cycles_background
cell_options.label: Refresh button cycles the background
cell_options.help: On: each refresh press goes white, blue, black (map it to print_blueprint_cycle). Dashboard look and Off just redraw the frame.

cell_options.name: panel
cell_options.label: Panel
cell_options.help: Auto reads the panel of the screen the sheet is drawn for; colour where it can't tell.

cell_options.name: callout_notes
cell_options.label: Callout notes
cell_options.help: The small lines under each callout's heading.

cell_options.name: fill_space
cell_options.label: Sensor panels
cell_options.help: Temperatures, AMS, fans and machine panels in empty side space on wide sheets.

cell_options.name: show_grid
cell_options.label: Blueprint grid
cell_options.help: Default: on for blueprint, dashboard and cell looks, off for white and black. On or Off overrides it.

cell_options.name: show_subtitle
cell_options.label: Title line
cell_options.help: The printer line under the title.

settings.name: kie_api_key
settings.label: kie.ai API key
settings.help: Only for the AI engraving picture. Get one at kie.ai/api-key.

settings.name: ai_daily_cap
settings.label: AI pictures per day
settings.help: At most this many AI pictures a day across all printers. One picture per print, about US$0.02 each.
